prompt:

Everything below the collarbones is an open lattice with wide gaps, so the surroundings and their light show straight through between the lines, while her real face, ears and neck stay opaque living flesh, and the rebar edge rises in a small raised step at the base of the neck.

Broad powerful shoulders, a wide heavy chest, a large round soft belly hanging over a thick waist, thick strong arms, and wide heavy thighs beneath. Every curve is large, solid and continuous, with a warm, imposing bearing. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Body Art: full body polished white marble fused directly to his own form wrapping his whole body from the collarbones to the ankles, both legs carved all the way down to the ankles — this is solid stone curving to follow his body's true three-dimensional shape, divided into dozens of fitted stone sections, each joint standing in a thin raised ridge catching its own bright glint and casting its own small shadow, every section standing proud of the next. Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each material catching the warm low sun in glowing glints, the golden light carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
